text:
marta (PM): Quick sync re: ACME pilot ETA 2026-04-01. Need to lock minimal launch scope and cross-team gates. Main constraints: KV cache change on runtime, CMK onboarding, and staging prewarm. Who takes ownership for each?

alex (Eng): I can drive the runtime changes. Need an MVP acceptance checklist. Is a canary without CMK acceptable temporarily?

sam (Runtime): Canary without CMK is okay only with a clear fallback and audit events. Perf note: KV change may add ~8ms p95; will test.

jess (Infra): Prewarm options: provision Dedicated (week+ticket) or use burstable Hosted (quota request ~3d). Which do we prefer?

marta (PM): Use burstable to move fast. If sustained >70% for 48h, we convert to Dedicated. Agree?

casey (SRE): OK. I'll create an alert: `sustained_utilization > 70% for 2h` and a runbook to escalate. Who signs conversion approvals?

marta (PM): Product + Finance to approve capacity commits.

li (Security): CMK onboarding needs HSM and key-rotation policy review. Earliest security review is 2026-03-18. If you do canary sans-CMK, provide a data-separation design and ENC-in-transit proof.

alex (Eng): Proposed acceptance checklist:
1) E2E generation on ACME test tenant with prefix cache
2) Fallback flow validated on simulated KMS failure
3) Staging latency p95 < 120ms
4) Canary feature flag + rollback path

marta (PM): Add: 5) Security review sign-off (li) 6) Infra prewarm config applied (jess).

sam (Runtime): I'll run a perf matrix and share tuning options by EOD Fri. If p95 exceeds target, we'll try adaptive batching and fewer KV lookups for short prompts.

jess (Infra): I'll open INFRA-4321 and start quota request today. ETA: pool ready 48h after quota approval.

li (Security): I'll reserve a review slot; need design doc + threat model by Thu noon. If not ready, list temporary mitigations.

casey (SRE): Runbook + alert created. Will add the maintenance window note.

marta (PM): Action items: alex: delivery plan + rollback flag (Thu COB); sam: perf matrix (Fri EOD); jess: INFRA-4321 + provision (start today); li: security review slot (awaiting doc); casey: alert & runbook. Reply with "ack" to own items.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack — posting perf results to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack — opened INFRA-4321: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4321

deploy-bot: Note: maintenance 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary deploys blocked during window :no_entry_sign:

marta (PM): Please avoid scheduling ACME canary in that window. If provisioning delays happen, we'll reschedule.

casey (SRE): Will flag window in runbook. If pool is ready earlier, we can slide canary earlier.

li (Security): Reminder: include CMK rotation sequence in design doc or appendix.

alex (Eng): Will add rotation steps and brief rollback appendix.

marta (PM): I'll compile a launch checklist and post dates after Thursday updates. :thumbsup:

sam (Runtime): If sub-100ms p95 is required, lock batching params before provisioning — will recommend defaults in perf post.

jess (Infra): INFRA-4321 created.

marta (PM): Thanks team, closing unless blockers emerge.
